content.title: RA (Residential / Agricultural) District
content.summary: The RA (Residential/Agricultural) District is designed to maintain a semi-rural character through large-lot single-family residential neighborhoods and various agricultural uses. It outlines specific classifications for allowed uses, including residential, hospitality, commercial, community, industrial, utility, and agricultural activities, each with designated allowances and additional regulations as specified in the Land Development Code. If a use is not listed, it is prohibited in this zoning district.
content.body:
Intended to provide for "semi-rural (rural, countryside, or estate) character, in the form of large-lot single-family residential neighborhoods; and agriculture, urban agriculture, greenhouses, stables, or other equestrian uses.

Acronyms:

- Allowed Use By-Right (A)
- Limited Use (L)
- Conditional Use (C)

**Note**: If a use is not listed in the table then it is not allowed in the zoning district
